Question Choices: Select which is closest to how long a boat is ~~8-centimeters | 8-meters~~
Solution: A boat is several meters long. Eight meters is reasonable; eight centimeters is far too short.

Question Choices: Select which you would measure in inches ~~computer-mouse | door | football-field~~
Solution: A computer mouse is small, so inches are a convenient unit. A door or football field is much larger.

Question Choices: Select which you would measure in feet ~~hallway | eraser | laptop-screen~~
Solution: A hallway is long, so feet give a convenient measurement. Erasers and laptop screens are much smaller.

Question Choices: Select which is closest to how tall a tree is ~~20-feet | 20-inches~~
Solution: A tree can be about twenty feet tall. Twenty inches would be too short for the typical tree described.

Question Choices: Select which is closest to how tall a paperclip is ~~1-foot | 1-inch~~
Solution: A paperclip is small. One inch is reasonable, while one foot is much too long.
